schema.title: How the staging directories of the shared store are owned and retired
schema.description: A process that stages a directory tree below `<store>/v1/tmp` (cold unit copies, guest build trees) creates it with `createStagingTreeV1`: the name `<originId>.<label>.<pid>.<startMs>.<hex16>` carries the owner as the shared process identity (pid together with the creation time of the process, `🏃️process/🔖️identity`), because a pid alone does not name a process. The sweep keeps every directory whose owner is proven alive, whatever its age. A directory without a proven live owner (a dead owner, a pid reused by another process, another machine's origin, or a name that registers no owner) is retired once no entry below it was modified for `graceMilliseconds`; a tree with more than `maximumEntries` entries is kept because its newest write cannot be proven. Loose files go after `fileGraceMilliseconds`. Never a link, never a `.nfs` placeholder.
